article.headline: Isaac Tavares, Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt lead Southern Miss to 99-89 victory over Valparaiso
article.description: — Isaac Tavares and Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt both scored 17 points as Southern Mississippi beat Valparaiso 99-89 on Sunday.
article.linkText: Isaac Tavares, Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt lead Southern Miss to 99-89 victory over Valparaiso

categories.description: Southern Miss Golden Eagles @ Valparaiso Beacons

event.description: Southern Miss Golden Eagles @ Valparaiso Beacons

keywords: Southern Miss Golden Eagles @ Valparaiso Beacons
article.story: PENSACOLA, Fla. -- — Isaac Tavares and Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt both scored 17 points as Southern Mississippi beat Valparaiso 99-89 on Sunday. Tavares also contributed six rebounds and three steals for the Golden Eagles (5-3). Anthony Igiede had 16 points and shot 6 of 12 from the field and 4 of 5 from the free-throw line. Rajan Roberts led the way for the Beacons (4-2) with 24 points. J.T. Pettigrew added 20 points and seven rebounds, while Carter Hopoi finished with 17 points. Southern Miss took the lead with 18:55 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Cameron Wallace led the team in scoring with 14 points for a 56-35 lead at the break. Up next: Southern Miss’ next game is Sunday against Grambling at home. Valparaiso hosts Toledo on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
